task.title: Add another person
task.shortdesc: Add a person to a tree that already has someone in it.

context.p: The first person comes with a new tree. After that, you add people with .

stepresult.p: A sheet named fills the screen. If a person is open, it starts with things you can add to that person.

step.cmd: Scroll down to the part named .
Choose , then choose at the bottom.

info.p: The button stays grey until you choose a form.

step.cmd: Type the names, choose the sex and add the dates and places you know.

info.p: Only is needed. For a date, type the day and the year and choose the month from the list. A line under the date says how the app reads it, such as Reads as 17 March 1777.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom of the form and choose .

stepresult.p: You go back to the screen you came from. The new person is in your tree.

result.p: If the name is already in the tree, a small box asks first, beside the form. It has a button for the person who is there, written with their name and years, and a button that starts . Choose if you meant the same person. Choose the other button if two people share a name. To close the box without choosing, choose a place outside it. The form stays as it was.

The sheet ends with , with a count in brackets. Choose it to see the forms that do not fit this person. Each one has a line under it that says why. For example, This form covers 1871, and going by the dates in the tree, nobody here was alive then.
